name: Clean
long_description: Clean watches your market and finds your buyers from what companies actually do: customs shipments, permits, loans and supplier switches. Not just ads or web clicks.
one_liner: We tell sellers exactly when a company is ready to buy.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder @ Clean. 2x founder. Prev. Head of Community @ Cliqk, growing it to 10k+ users, 300k in revenue & 28M+ views. Enterprise Sales @ Cisco at 18. Ex. UCSD.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Clean (YC F26). Previously ML Engineer at Todd Agriscience, where he built the AI platform that anchored a $40M raise and served 6k+ farmers. Founded DocIQ (100+ users, 20 paying customers in weeks). Won HackHarvard 2025. CS @ Arizona State.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at Clean (YC F26). Previously built Lokus (5K+ users in 24 hours). Research intern at Dhirubhai Ambani University, where he built RL pipelines using GRPO that achieved 20% higher accuracy than PPO for medical LLM question-answering. At DAIICT, built an LLM self-correction framework using PPO that improved math reasoning accuracy by 60% on GSM8K benchmarks. BS Computer Science at Gannon University.

founders.title: Founder/CPO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder at Clean (YC F26). International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) and Asian Physics Olympiad (APhO). Prev. Ruangguru. AAAI 2026. Existential Robotics Lab.
